identity.product_outcome: A source-bound Intent Capsule and destination-capability semantic-continuity foundation that preserves canonical intent meaning across destination assessment without claiming cross-DAW equivalence or execution.
identity.artist_job: Carry the meaning of an exact creative intent forward when considering another workspace or destination without fabricating capability, equivalence, render/freeze work or DAW action.

bounded_increment.description: Reconstruct and harden source-bound Intent Capsules, conflict/freshness resolution, append-only revalidation and destination capability snapshots.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Derive intent only from canonical versioned creative USER_DECLARED intent evidence, resolve source truth with exact specificity/conflict/freshness semantics, serialize semantic duplicate creation, preserve source key through append-only revalidation, and assess destination capability without granting execution or equivalence authority.
non_negotiable_semantics: intent semantics derive only from canonical versioned intent.semantic.* USER_DECLARED CREATIVE payloads
VERSION precedes SONG, ARTIST and PROFILE for same-key current source truth
ambiguous active source truth fails closed
semantic duplicate detection and representation insertion are atomic across independent Headquarters connections
append-only revalidation preserves original semantic source key as well as capsule semantics
stale source or workspace truth requires append-only revalidation
contradictory destination capability resolves UNKNOWN or NEEDS_EVIDENCE
destination workspace/runtime/capability movement during assessment fails closed
technical evidence is not artist intent and route availability is not semantic transfer or proprietary equivalence
no Recipe/Version creation, Song/Version/Learning mutation, DAW/provider call, approval, purchase, publication or external action is authorized
allowed_implementation_freedom: private internal substrate behind the hardened public service
internal query organization when exact semantic ownership is preserved
interpretations_required: The service-owned intent.capsule.* representation namespace is case-sensitive.
Canonical source and representation schema version 1 requires exact integer type, not Python-equal bool/float/string values.

behavior.requested_behavior: Preserve source-bound creative intent semantics while assessing destination capability and continuity.
behavior.implemented_behavior: Hardened public service resolves canonical source truth, serializes duplicate creation, performs append-only revalidation and destination snapshot checks, while preserving strict no-execution and no-equivalence boundaries.

consumer_path.reason: The PR explicitly does not claim consumer reachability; this is the reusable foundation.

apis: Intent Capsule source and destination capability service
persistence: SQLite-backed immutable/append-only capsule representations and revalidation
schemas: source and representation schema version 1 with exact typed validation required
platform_implications: SQLite transaction and type/case semantics require cross-platform proof

semantic_assumptions: technical/capability evidence never becomes artist intent or cross-DAW equivalence
collision_surfaces: four historical governance activation files collide with the repaired Steward integration model

validation.regression_proof: Fresh exact-head regression is required after the two product findings are repaired and again after Steward reconstruction if the head changes.
validation.consumer_smoke: No direct consumer route is claimed by this foundation; repository staged smoke remains a required integration regression guard.
validation.full_regression: Fresh full repository regression is required because this change affects persistent semantic identity and concurrency.
validation.migration_proof: No persistence migration is claimed; representation validation must remain compatible with the bounded schema contract.
validation.recovery_proof: Fresh append-only revalidation, immutability and concurrent-connection recovery proof is required after fixes.
validation.security_privacy_rights_proof: No DAW/provider/external action authority is granted; destination assessment is read/semantic only.
validation.cross_platform_proof: Fresh Linux/Windows/macOS exact-head proof is required after the product fix and final reconstruction.

unresolved_findings: Owned intent.capsule.* representation and supersession scans must be case-sensitive; generic upper-case variants must not be consumed through SQLite LIKE.
Source and representation schema version must require exact integer type 1; bool, float, string or other Python-equal values must fail closed.
reviewer_assumptions: The Steward-owned #206 governance repair is not duplicated in this Builder branch.
Historical governance activation files are discarded/reconstructed under the repaired Steward model rather than carried forward by adjacency.

failure_modes: case-insensitive namespace capture changes semantic ownership
non-integer schema values pass as version 1
revalidation resurrects meaning under another intent key
stale destination evidence is treated current
rollback_recovery_considerations: preserve immutable historical capsule evidence; revert public wrapper changes without rewriting canonical source evidence; revalidate from exact source truth

external_dependencies: future Steward reconstruction after incident #206 sequencing
